claim: A photograph shows a newborn child who weighed 8.6 kg (18.96 lbs.) at birth.
label: half
explain: In August 2018, Facebook users encountered multiple postings of a photograph of what looked to be a very large newborn child, accompanied by text suggesting the baby weighed in at a whopping 8.6 kilograms (18.96 pounds) — said to be a Guinness World Record for “the biggest baby born by natural birth”:This photograph has been online since at least as far back as March 2017, with varying weights offered for the pictured child.  We haven’t yet been able to tie the photograph to any details documenting the identity of the pictured child, its birth weight, or the date and circumstances of its birth. or link the picture with any news story or other report about the birth of an extraordinarily large baby.We can note that the current Guinness World Record for “Heaviest Birth” is a 9.98 kg (22 lb.) boy born in 1879 to a 7 ft. 11 in. Ohio woman who was also part of a Guinness World Record for “Tallest Married Couple“:  Many commenters have pointed to news accounts of the 2009 birth (by cesarean section) of a child in Indonesia whose weight (8.7 kilograms, or 19.2 pounds) was even greater than that claimed of the child pictured above:But again, we haven’t yet found anything definitively linking the viral photograph at the head of this article to that Indonesian birth, or to any of the other reported births of unusually large babies in recent years.

However , within two week , most newborn regain all the weight they have lose and return to their birth weight . After that , your child should settle back down into a more regular feeding routine . On average , baby gain about one pound each month for the first six month . Mothers be breastfeed more and more and the WHO chart be consider a standard on how child should grow . Your child 's doctor be the best source of information when it come to your child 's growth and development . This will allow them to notice any diversion from your child 's anticipated growth , base on history , and address any possible concern quickly , if applicable . The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention ( CDC ) provide a set of growth chart that include old data and information from a combination of feed method . Healthy baby can be a range of size , but the course of development tends to be fairly predictable . Healthy infant can be in the 5th percentile as well a the 95th percentile .
